name: Needle
subtitle: Your music, on your iPhone.
description: Needle for iPhone, for SideStore and AltStore. Each phone signs it with its own Apple ID.

apps.name: Needle
apps.subtitle: Your music, on your iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription:
Needle is a music player for the songs you own.

- Your library on your iPhone, made for Liquid Glass.
- A full player in the cover's colours, with lyrics that follow the song word by word.
- Lock Screen, Control Center, AirPlay, Bluetooth, Chromecast and DLNA speakers.
- Widgets for the song playing, recent albums, playlists and your week of listening.
- Navidrome and other music servers built in, with a page for your server.
- Moving covers, from your folders or your server.
- A Radio tab: stations from the songs you play most.
- Control Needle on your computer, and move what plays between the computer and the phone.
- A 10-band and parametric equalizer, headphone corrections, crossfeed and crossfade.
- Playlists, smart playlists, tag editing, and tools to find duplicates and covers.
- Discord status: show what you play on your profile.

No account and no tracking. Needle goes online only for things that you turn on.

versions.localizedDescription:
Needle 2.0: a new look, and a lot more to see and hear.

- A new Home and icon, in amber.
- Four looks for the player: Cover, Record, Lyrics, and Visualizer.
- Choose the player's buttons, its seek bar, and your fonts.
- A new Search, with lines of lyrics.
- Lyric cards, and lyrics in your language.
- Better artists, with pictures you choose.
- A record crate, the genre map, and your year in music.
- A sleep timer, speed and pitch, and smart mixes.
- Turn your iPhone sideways, or open an iPhone Duo, and Needle spreads out.

Navidrome built in, a Radio tab, moving covers, and calmer Settings.

- Navidrome and Subsonic, built in: sign in in Settings › Music server, with no plugin to add. A page shows your server, its songs, albums, and artists. Refresh everything gets every song and cover again.
- Moving covers: an animated WebP or GIF beside an album's songs, or the album's moving cover on your server, moves in the player. On mobile data, no new ones are downloaded unless you turn it on.
- A Radio tab in place of Sources, and a new Home.
- Calmer Settings, and a neater What's new and welcome screen.
- Music that keeps playing when the network sleeps.
- Lyrics under the mini player.
- Last.fm in one click.

Fixes for covers and crash reports.

- Covers that are not square (a tall Blu-ray cover, a wide one) fill their tile, the same size as the rest.
- With crash reports on, Needle also sends the crashes iOS tells it of. They tell what went wrong and where in the app, with no names and no files.

Albums and artists after Apple Music, a player you can sink into, and a long list of fixes.

- Album and artist pages after Apple Music: the cover across the top, pages in their own colours, and artist pages with a tall photo and their logo.
- An immersive player: the cover fills the top, and moving covers play there.
- Plain controls, a thin volume line, and Up Next after Apple Music.
- Opening Needle no longer stops another app's sound.
- Crash reports are your choice on the welcome screen.
- Play on an artist's page plays all their songs.
- Removing a music folder asks first.
- Many fixes for lyrics, Discord, widgets, the sleep timer, and your music server.

Needle for iPhone, now on SideStore.

- Discord status: link your Discord account in Settings › Discord, and your profile shows what you play.
- Lyrics from your music server: songs from Navidrome get the lyrics your server has, even with online lookups off.
- When a song has no lyrics, a button turns on online lookups.
- Long lyric lines no longer run past the edge of the screen.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Needle reads the QR code of the phone remote on your computer.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Needle connects to Needle on your computer and to music servers on your home network.
